name: ROR (Research Organization Registry) API
summary: Open registry of research organizations with persistent ROR ids, names, locations, types and relationships; searchable and matchable to affiliation strings.
description: ROR assigns persistent identifiers to universities, institutes, funders, companies and other research organizations, with display and alternate names, country and city (GeoNames), organization types, status, domains, links and parent/child/related relationships, plus crosswalked ids (GRID, Wikidata, ISNI, Crossref Funder ID). The v2 API supports search, filters, and affiliation matching. The whole registry is also a CC0 dump on Zenodo.

auth.notes: No registration required; docs offer a client id (free registration) for higher limits.

rate_limit.summary: Max 2000 requests per 5-minute period per IP address (docs); a registered client id raises it. Traffic peaks around midnight UTC.

endpoints.summary: Search organizations by name, or filter
One organization by ROR id (the bare 9-character suffix)

agent_notes: Search with ?query= for names or ?affiliation= to match a messy affiliation string (returns a score and a chosen flag). Filters look like filter=country.country_code:DE,types:funder. Lists return 20 per page; ROR ids are https://ror.org/<id> but the path takes only the id suffix.
caveats: Page size is fixed at 20 items.
update_frequency is a best guess; the release cadence was not confirmed.
The query harvard returned 34 matches including facilities and groups, not only Harvard University.
